batch: MiTeC Weather Agent and Mail Checker full-collection scope reassessment

scope.userDecision: 2026-10-27 full MiTeC collection selection; include products unless end-of-life or a reproducible material source/product error makes migration unsuitable; record temporary holds by product.
scope.priorDisposition: 2026-10-22 drop/retirement wording is superseded for collection review by the later selection. Neither product is marked retired in this reassessment.

weatherAgent.publisherPageObservation: Current historical product page lists Windows 2000 through Windows 10 and free private/commercial use; no end-of-life statement found on the page.
weatherAgent.staticProductFinding: The executable contains HTTP templates for OpenWeatherMap /data/2.5/find, /weather, /forecast and /forecast/daily. Each includes an APPID format placeholder and a location placeholder.

observations: The provider's current current-weather example uses HTTPS.
The provider marks appid as required and identifies it as the user's unique API key.
The provider says built-in city/ZIP/city-ID geocoding is deprecated and no longer receives bug fixes or updates.

weatherAgent.inferenceAndLimits: If Weather Agent uses its embedded HTTP request templates as written, the API key and selected location are sent in plaintext. Runtime request selection, redirects and key persistence were not tested; the source templates themselves are reproducible static evidence.
weatherAgent.disposition: Temporary product-security hold: exclude from the selectable v3 catalog until a publisher build uses HTTPS or an equivalent source correction is verified. Do not run with a real API key or personal location. This is a technical source/product issue, not a license decision or end-of-life finding.

publisherPageObservations: The publisher describes SSL email retrieval, including Gmail, SMTP send/reply, and message deletion.
The historical page lists Windows 2000 through Windows 7 and free private/commercial use; no end-of-life statement found on the page.
The current support EULA describes unregistered versions as freeware for non-commercial use.
mailChecker.staticSecurityFinding: The extracted package includes unsigned OpenSSL-identified 1.0.1e DLLs. The official OpenSSL page says the 1.0.1 branch has been unsupported since 2017 and documents vulnerabilities affecting pre-1.0.1g versions.
mailChecker.runtimeLimit: The Mail Checker executable has no direct static import of these DLL names. Dynamic loading and actual TLS exposure are unverified; no application, DLL, account, network request, send, or delete action was run.

catalogDisposition.securityGate: Verify dependency use and TLS behavior only against a local synthetic mail sink; never use real credentials. Windows 11 is exploratory because the publisher page only lists support through Windows 7.

validation.repositoryValidation: Passed: 451 operations, 8 groups, 5 profiles and 305 PowerShell files.
validation.testSourceParsing: Passed for the Mail Checker and Paradox Data Editor Pester 5 test files.
validation.retainedMailInstallerHash: Passed; local file matches frozen static extraction evidence and candidate pin.
validation.pesterExecution: Not run: only Pester 3.4.0 is available; both focused suites are authored for Pester 5.

estimates.reasonUnchanged: Weather Agent remains a temporary hold in the full-collection scope and Mail Checker is now a source-ready pending candidate; neither whole legacy outcome is closed, so both remain represented in the current unresolved package range.
